The administration is looking for industry to step in amid cuts to federal science research funding.

items.title: Should We Track AI Chips?
items.excerpt: CSET’s Jacob Feldgoise, Kyle Miller, and Hanna Dohmen dove deep into investigating how location verification methods can—and cannot—improve enforcement of export controls on powerful AI chips, culminating in their report. I sat down with Jacob to learn more about the issue, their findings, and what those findings mean for mitigating AI chip smuggling.
